source_report: Currency Tokenisation Race - Macro Research, January 2026
source_page: Figure 2: Balance sheets of the consolidated sectors of the model economy (p.7, after Abad et al. 2024)
method: Dark-mode redraw of the published balance-sheet figure for a 9:16 card, built sector by sector and then linked. Every sector, item and cross-sector claim is taken from the figure.
palette: Dark visual system shared by all five divisions: near-black ground, white primary content, the design system's light purple (#AFA2D2) and a muted pink sibling (#CDA2BF) as accents, grey for structure.
